text: Where does every item's activity actually show up? The monitoring hub.

Databricks Lesson 11 covered run history, per job. Fabric's monitoring hub does the same job, but across every item type at once — notebooks, pipelines, dataflows, and eventstreams later on — all in one unified list.
One row shows the item, its type, status, start time, and duration — filterable by any of those. Genuinely useful as a first stop for did last night's pipeline actually run.
And drilling into a failed run shows the real error, which step failed, and what downstream work never even got a chance to run — the same triage instinct as reading the actual error before guessing.
What ran, when, did it succeed — the same question Databricks' run history answers, just at tenant scope here. Chapter 1 complete. Next: real-time data engineering, after one quick recap.
